title: Leo's Art Gallery
welcome: Walk the hall, pick a favorite, and pledge to bring a copy home.
bio: Leo (age 4½) is a Pre-K artist known for bold, colorful work in a variety of mediums. When he isn’t in the studio, he can be found baking with his mama, riding his bike, swimming, and enjoying music fun time.

His influences include the podcasts Curious Kids Everyday, Deep Blue Sea, Thomas & Friends Storytime and Sleepytime Pups. He is a keen player of board games, especially Snakes and Ladders and Operation. In his spare time, he redesigns playgrounds with his dada.
